description: Verify exact decomposition, reconstruction, alignment, and residual orthogonality for a small inspectable respiratory subspace.

oracle.description: The 1 Hz dominant frequency gives delay 2 and delayed_m = [1,2,3,4,5]. The two V columns are [1,0,-1,0,1] and [0,-1,0,1,0], with Gram diagonal [3,2]. Projection gives [1,-1,-1,1,1]; the residual [0,3,4,3,4] has exactly zero inner product with both columns, and the components reconstruct delayed_m exactly.
